cohort: 893,360 singleton live births of at least 33 weeks gestation without major congenital conditions born in hospitals in New South Wales, Australia, from 2001 to 2011
finding: Vaginal birth after spontaneous labor onset at 39+ weeks gestation and any breastfeeding were associated with the lowest risk of gastroenteritis hospitalization in early childhood.
mod_finding: Infants born via cesarean section had a 20% increased risk of AGE admission compared to those born vaginally.
